The presentative 'there is' is placed on the predicate noun זְמָן rather than on the fronted לַ under rule 49. The competing reading treats לַכֹּל as the clause's prepositional predicate and would put the copula there; it was rejected because the ASV writes a presentative frame rather than a bare copula, and rules 20, 21 and 50 anchor such a frame on the existential's nominal anchor. ECC.3.17 writes the same construction with the preposition following and is read the same way.
s008-s009 (כָל־חֵפֶץ) is rendered attributively as 'every purpose' with no 'of', so rule 28 governs and rule 19's relational expression is not imposed; the written לְ keeps the 'for'.
